import json, os, subprocess, sys, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

source=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
target=Path("/Users/steventran/Sonary")
sys.path.insert(0,str(source/"src"))
from do_again.service.rollout import _tree_hash

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(source/"src")

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=source,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False,env=env)

key=hashlib.sha256(str(target.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
root=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key

dry=run(["python3","-m","do_again.cli","upgrade",str(target)])

print(json.dumps({
  "source_head":run(["git","-C",str(source),"rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip(),
  "source_hash":_tree_hash(source/"src/do_again"),
  "runtime_hash":_tree_hash(root/"runtime/do_again"),
  "dry_run":{"rc":dry.returncode,"stdout":dry.stdout,"stderr":dry.stderr},
},indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print("SONARY_POST_RECOVERY_UPGRADE_PREFLIGHT_OK")
